name: Aura of Ephelomon
description: Any creature of the gith's choice that is within 30 feet of the gith and aware of it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effects ends for it, the creature is immune to the effect for the next 24 hours.
